comparison.objective: Transfer a loaded tray from temporary support to a shelf before withdrawing the supporting hand, unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transfer, containment, shelf placement, and sequenced support withdrawal; no small-tool or adjustment mechanics.
comparison.success_condition: Tray and two tins reach the shelf, tins remain below the tray rim, then the hand withdraws; pose tolerances and damage/drop limits are otherwise unspecified.
comparison.reason: Tests load-support transfer and containment rather than mechanical adjustment.
